mentions.name: Merge conflicts tool
mentions.description: A beta-ready merge conflicts product, one of two tools in a suite of simpler, faster, and lighter alternatives to CI/CD containers and merge queues, with a public demo available online.
mentions.problem: Traditional CI/CD containers and merge queues are complex, slow, and heavyweight.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently two products are beta-ready (merge conflicts/codeowners) and the demos are available here: https://codeinput.com/products/code-owners/demo and here: https://codeinput.com/products/merge-conflicts/demo
